project_type: ASP.NET Core 8 MVC, cookie auth, SQLite via EF Core 9
build_system: dotnet SDK, net8.0 target, csproj at c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters\Scooters.csproj
test_framework: none — no test project exists; verify by building and running the app
verification_instructions: Run `dotnet build c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters\Scooters.csproj` and confirm 'Build succeeded'. Then run `dotnet run --project c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters\Scooters.csproj` and verify the app starts (port in launchSettings.json). Migrations are applied automatically on startup via db.Database.Migrate() in Program.cs. For EF migrations use `dotnet ef migrations add <Name> --project c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: Migrations/ folder — generated by `dotnet ef migrations add <Name> --project c:\Users\Students\MVC\MVC\Scooters`. AppDbContextModelSnapshot.cs is auto-regenerated. Database file: Database/scooters.db (auto-created at runtime).
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. The Database/ folder is created by Program.cs at runtime. Never delete Database/scooters.db manually during development — migrations run automatically. EF tools require `dotnet ef` CLI (Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Tools 9.0.9 already in csproj).
contribution_requirements: All labels in Bulgarian. Bootstrap 5 only (no new CSS frameworks). Follow existing patterns: [Route("[controller]/[action]")] on controllers that use it, async/await throughout, [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] on all POST actions, IPasswordHasher<User> for passwords. Keep comments in Bulgarian matching existing style.
key_patterns: 1) Controllers use constructor DI for AppDbContext and services. 2) CartController/ProductController use [Route("[controller]/[action]")] + [HttpGet]/[HttpPost] — AccountController does NOT use that attribute, uses conventional routing. 3) Views use asp-controller/asp-action tag helpers. 4) TempData["Success"] and TempData["Error"] display banners via _Layout.cshtml. 5) User.Id is a Guid stored as ClaimTypes.NameIdentifier. 6) Models use [Required], [StringLength], [Range] data annotations. 7) CartService stores cart in session as JSON. 8) DbSeeder.Seed() checks .Any() before inserting.
directory_structure: Scooters/ — root; Controllers/ — 5 controllers; Data/ — AppDbContext, AppDbContextFactory, DbSeeder; Database/ — scooters.db (SQLite, gitignored); Migrations/ — 3 migrations + snapshot; Models/ — CartItem, ErrorViewModel, LoginViewModel, Product, RegisterViewModel, User; Services/ — CartService, ImageUploadService, ProductService; Views/ — Account/, Cart/, Home/, Product/, Routing/, Shared/; wwwroot/ — lib/bootstrap, css/site.css, images/, js/; Attributes/ — MultipleOfThreeAttribute; .agents/tasks/ — plan artifacts
